remarks: As you enter 101 Murray Street you will be WOWED.  Sun drenched rooms will welcome you to this gracious home with a beautiful deck to relax and entertain your guests. This beautifully decorated ranch has been impeccably maintained and renovated with attention to detail. There is so much NEW here! Gas range, microwave and dishwasher are all new out of the box high end BERTAZZONI and are the belle's of the gourmet kitchen complete with Ann Sack's designer custom tile backsplash. More NEW: Primary Bedroom ensuite bathroom and renovation of existing 2 additional baths, all with HIGH END KOHLER. Central Air has been added; laundry re located to main level off kitchen(New LG W/D); new hot water heater and updated electrical. The house has a spacious living room with a separate formal dining area. Additionally, the family room is conveniently located off the stunnning eat in kitchen. Sliders lead to a lovely landscaped yard on a corner lot to be enjoyed by all including your furry friends. Did we mention the electric pet fence is NEW too?? Please look at the comprehensive list of improvements attached. And such a convenient location on the Westport/Norwalk border in beautiful leafy CT. 101 Murray Street is not to be missed! Come take a look!
